entities.name: @okie/server
entities.responsibility: Loopback scan HTTP process that serves paste-a-repo jobs, published scan objects, and optional Ask Atlas answers against an OpenAI-compatible gateway. GET /healthz stays key-free.

entities.name: src/ask.ts
entities.responsibility: One-shot Ask Atlas Q&A grounded in client-supplied packets and accepted summaries; disconnected when no gateway key is present.

entities.name: src/enrichment.ts
entities.responsibility: Hosted enrichment pass that posts bounded packets to the configured LLM gateway and feeds replies through the existing merge gate.

entities.name: src/githubAccess.ts
entities.responsibility: Resolves GitHub HTTP clients for hosted scan: OAuth bearer, anonymous, or the loopback test double — never operator gh or env tokens.

entities.name: src/githubOAuth.ts
entities.responsibility: GitHub OAuth start/callback with CSRF state cookies; tokens stay in the in-memory session.

entities.name: src/globalSpend.ts
entities.responsibility: Process-wide enrichment spend ceiling across GitHub users, orthogonal to the per-user submit limiter.

entities.name: src/jobs.ts
entities.responsibility: In-memory scan job queue, stages, and the per-user / per-IP submit limiter.

entities.name: src/llmGateway.ts
entities.responsibility: Resolves the OpenAI-compatible gateway from env and gitignored local config; never returns the key on public endpoints.

entities.name: src/localDefaults.ts
entities.responsibility: Loopback listen defaults and hosted-scan posture for the local operator process.

entities.name: src/main.ts
entities.responsibility: Process entry that wires GitHub auth, the scan job runner, Ask Atlas, and the loopback HTTP server.

entities.name: src/repoUrl.ts
entities.responsibility: Normalizes a pasted repository URL onto the scan GitHub source shape.

entities.name: src/scanObjects.ts
entities.responsibility: Safe path resolution for published scan JSON objects under the scan root.

entities.name: src/scanServer.ts
entities.responsibility: HTTP handlers for healthz, auth, scan jobs, Ask Atlas, and /scan/* objects.

entities.name: src/scanService.ts
entities.responsibility: Runs a GitHub scan job, optionally enriches, and publishes the snapshot trio plus enrichment report.

entities.name: answerAskQuestion
entities.responsibility: Answers one Ask Atlas question from submitted packets and summaries, or reports the gateway as disconnected.
